new_result.name: exact single-scale compact-tent normal form for N3
new_result.statement: For fixed tau in (0,1], the sharp Claude N3 constant equals sup s_3(A) E(1-|X^TAX-y|)_+ over the homogeneous scale-free no-pivot class |A_ii|<tau s_3(A), |A_iiA_jj-A_ij^2|<tau s_3(A)^2. The same supremum is unchanged when all marginals are restricted to indicators of bounded finite unions of intervals of measure one, with no uniform fragment-count restriction.
new_result.application: Any finite C0 for this one fixed-tent finite-fragment inequality gives the full QFORM theorem through the completed Claude transfer with C_full <= tau^(-1/2) max{1+2exp(pi)C0, 1+3K_tau}, K_tau=(2/sqrt(tau))[6.2+log_+(16sqrt(tau))].
